typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	RCtblSLACPauditcrfmdata_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		CUSIP as string,
		EFFDATE as timestamp,
		BGNREF as string,
		ClientID as string,
		QTY as integer,
		BL as string,
		origin as string,
		LNVAL as integer,
		SSET_DT as timestamp,
		CPTY as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FACSEDSLoanPosition
FACSEDSLoanPosition sink(input(
		cusip as string,
		effDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ContractNumber as string,
		clientId as string,
		quantity as string,
		borrowLoan as string,
		origin as string,
		contractAmount as string,
		deliveryDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		contraParty as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		cusip = CUSIP,
		effDate = EFFDATE,
		ContractNumber = BGNREF,
		clientId = ClientID,
		quantity = QTY,
		borrowLoan = BL,
		origin,
		contractAmount = LNVAL,
		deliveryDate = SSET_DT,
		contraParty = CPTY),
	partitionFileNames:[($RCtblSLACPauditcrfmdata_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> RCtblSLACPauditcrfmdata
